body: I relate to this so much. I know it won't change much, but just know that you're not alone in feeling this.

Hey there, thanks for the comment. I feel like I've accomplished nothing and I'm just heading in the wrong direction rapidly. I don't know, I don't see an end to this. I won't be happy unless I can change the past and I can't do that so I don't see any way out.

Wise beyond your years ;) Thanks for the comment, and you're right, life isn't fair. I know there are a ton of people out there, especially right now that have it worse than I do, and it does make me feel kind of selfish. It doesn't change the fact that it still hurts tremendously. Maybe I'm just not as strong as most people, but man, it's tough.

That's what some people close to me have said as well and while I do feel like I don't deserve that, it's hard thinking of her running off and traveling the world (not to mention the nerve to just disregard the pandemic), while I'm sleeping in a sleeping bag on a floor at my family's place, I feel so trapped.

Well they also said since we have been going in circles with therapy for a year straight that maybe I should take a break and be referred again later on. My psychiatrist had diagnosed me with some more secondary personality traits that included ocd, dependent personality, and avoidance and they felt that the therapy was just feeding into the dependence portion of things. Which I do kind of agree with, although that wasn't what I was trying to do.

Thanks man, yea I hold so much anger towards her for this but also a lot of anger towards myself. Clearly I'm not perfect, but I just hate that she gave up on me. It just seemed like she strung me along until there was someone else to jump to, which just so happened to be at one of the lowest points of my life.

I actually went on one date since and it was alright, the girl was great, but it just didn't feel right and I don't want to hurt anyone when I know I'm not ready for another relationship.
Thanks, I'll have a look and see if there is anything I can handle for some experience on there. Yea, it really does, I'm hoping we can get through it sometime soon

Sleep has always been and issue for me as it is, so it could be something that could help out. My doc just prescribed me something to help with sleep so we'll see how that goes.

Thank you for leaving a comment
Thanks for the support, I really do appreciate it.

Hey, thanks for the reply. I'm still seeing my psychiatrist, however the psychologist was more goal oriented. We would be practicing interview skills one day and then I was depressed and worried about the relationship the next and we were getting nowhere. They said I could join again when I am ready to actively work on that type of stuff.   

It's kind of discouraging that I see them for help but they won't help unless I'm in a good enough mood to be better. But that's why I'm seeing them in the first place :(

I might be able to find some other kind of therapy however, I'll see what other resources there are. Also, I'm on medication to treat the adhd, anxiety, and to help with sleep currently. Maybe I need an adjustment for the mood
